sources.docker-cli-v29.9.2: https://github.com/docker/cli/tree/v29.9.2: cli/command/formatter/reflect.go (--format '{{json .}}' marshals every exported method of a context without arguments, FullHeader left out), formatter/container.go (docker ps), network/formatter.go (docker network ls), formatter/volume.go (docker volume ls), formatter/image.go (docker image ls), formatter/disk_usage.go (docker system df, one line per Type, sizes by docker/go-units HumanSize), system/info.go (docker info --format, a template on the daemon's Info), cli/flags/options.go and container/opts.go, run.go, create.go (the options docker-label.ts skips); container/stop.go and rm.go, network/remove.go, volume/remove.go, image/remove.go (what each removal prints: the name given, or Untagged and Deleted lines for an image; network rm's status error, `exit status 1`, printed after its own line); cmd/docker/builder.go (`docker builder` runs buildx when it is installed, else the legacy builder's builder/prune.go, which takes no --max-used-space) and cmd/docker/docker.go (an error printed on stderr, exit 1); cli/cobra.go (FlagErrorFunc: an unknown flag's text, exit 125)
sources.moby-docker-v29.9.2: https://github.com/moby/moby/tree/docker-v29.9.2: api/types/volume/volume.go (docker volume inspect, a JSON list of Volume, CreatedAt, ClusterVolume, Status and UsageData omitted when empty), api/types/system/info.go (DockerRootDir, ServerVersion, SecurityOptions, Warnings), daemon/info.go (name=rootless in SecurityOptions; the warning of an API on TCP without TLS), client/errors.go (the daemon not reachable; `Error response from daemon: ` before each daemon error), daemon/delete.go (a running container), daemon/network.go and daemon/libnetwork/network.go, error.go (a network with endpoints, each `name:%q id:%q`), daemon/volume/service/errors.go (a volume in use, the containers' IDs), daemon/images/image_delete.go (an image a container uses)
sources.buildx-v0.38.1: https://github.com/docker/buildx/tree/v0.38.1: commands/prune.go (--max-used-space; its last line `Total:` and the size; the table of pruned records before it is left out by the fake)
